name: Crushed Ore

pages.title: Grinding
pages.text:
**Sneak** and right click a **Grindstone**. Your main hand can be empty, or holding the material.  
A plain right click still opens Repair and Disenchant, so the grindstone keeps its usual job. Drop the material in, take the dust out.

pages.title: Yield
pages.text:
Cheap ore grinds well, precious ore does not. The yield is the whole cost.

- Coal, Copper, Zinc: 4 dust.
- Lapis: 3 dust.
- Iron, Gold, Quartz, Amethyst: 2 dust.
- Diamond, Emerald: 1 dust.
- Netherite: 1 dust.

pages.title: Two exceptions
pages.text:
**Redstone** has no dust of ours, because the ore already drops one. Feed vanilla Redstone Dust to the chamber directly.  
**Netherite** takes the ingot, not scrap. That is four scrap and four gold for a single dust, and it is meant to be the most expensive thing you can attune to.
